designSystem: KYMBO FEED OS — an original social/feed design language built from scratch on the brand's foundation.
note: Only the FOUNDATION is inherited from brand guidelines: color, typography, the pixel motif, and the campaign message. Everything below — the surface rhythm, cover archetypes, layout grid, and visual furniture — is original design, not a reproduction of any prior style set.
voice: Profesional pero amigable — direct, numbers-first, confident, never salesy.
message: OTAs take 15–30%. Airbnb 15.5%. Your website takes 0%. Fire your middleman.

mediaNoche.role: Primary dark surface / ink on light.

pantalla.role: Primary light surface / text on dark.

verdePixel.role: Single accent. One hero element per slide. Never body copy.

typography.display: Satoshi (licensed) — stand-in Onest Variable. Oversized, tight, geometric.
typography.mono: Space Grotesk Variable — kickers, indices, units, the technical/pixel voice.
typography.note: CSS references 'Satoshi' first; drop the licensed woff2 into /fonts and it takes over with no code change.

foundation.motif: The pixel square — Kymbo's signature tell. Used as data cells, corner mark, bullets, and progress ticks.

myDesignLanguage.principle: Type-forward, editorial, high-contrast. One idea per slide, colossal type, generous negative space, exactly one lime accent.

surfaces.rhythm: Surfaces alternate by post order — in a 3-wide profile grid this yields a deliberate checkerboard. MEASURED CONSTRAINT: with 6 dark organic covers, a 12-tile month needs at least FOUR light covers to avoid both an all-dark column and a 3-dark row (three is provably not enough). Educational carousels ship a light cover by definition, so four of them per twelve resolves it.

furniture.kicker: Bracketed mono label, top-left. e.g. [ THE MATH ] — must name a REGISTERED pillar (see `pillars`).
furniture.footer: Pixel progress ticks only. Identical placement every slide.
furniture.removed: No K logo, no @kymbo handle, no SWIPE text, no CTA tagline — stripped by direction. Do not reintroduce.
furniture.safeZone: Instagram stamps a carousel glyph into the TOP-RIGHT corner of every tile. Cover headlines that start at the top must keep ~150x112px clear there (handled in styles.css by a float shim).

coverArchetypes.STAT: One colossal figure dominates; everything else whispers.
coverArchetypes.INDEX: Editorial — bracket kicker, ghosted giant index numeral behind a left-aligned headline.
coverArchetypes.MATRIX: The pixel grid as the hero visual (data / gallery energy).
coverArchetypes.SEAM: Hard split between dark and light surfaces; headline straddles a lime seam.
coverArchetypes.STATEMENT: The headline fills the whole canvas, tight leading, one lime word.

interiorLayouts: MOCKUP (in-brand device/UI, drawn in CSS — no stock photos)
myDesignLanguage.note2: Archetypes and layouts are a KIT the designer composes from with world-class judgement — not a rigid template rotation. The goal is bespoke, editorial craft that still reads as one brand; never a mechanical fill-in-the-blank.

pillars.note: Every kicker must come from this list. Batch 01 drifted and rendered [ EDUCATION ], [ MYTH-BUSTING ] and [ THE OFFER ] unregistered; they are now registered rather than silently reused.

productionPaths.note: Two ways to produce a carousel. Both share the same type system, furniture, palette and voice — so a scene post and an HTML post sit in one feed as one brand.
productionPaths.A_html: Pure design, drawn 100% in code. Text, spacing, typography and colour are perfectly consistent because they're systemised. Fully automatic — deliver immediately.
productionPaths.B_scene: Built ON TOP of AI-generated background images. Claude writes the complete vision first (structure + copy + layout + an exact per-slide image prompt), Kim generates the images in ChatGPT and sends them back, then Claude composites the type + hand-made organic accents on top, one slide at a time.
productionPaths.organicTouch: Path B is where the feed breathes — real scenes + a human, marked-up layer (marker swipes, hand underlines, strikethroughs, scribbled circles, hand-drawn arrows, cut-out subjects with a rough halo). Inspiration for the ENERGY only; the look stays 100% Kymbo (navy/cream/lime, geometric type, pixel motif) — never a copy of any reference account's style.
productionPaths.batchWorkflow: Work in batches of ~12 carousels. 1) Ship all Path-A (HTML) carousels first for approval. 2) Then name which ones need scenes and produce them one at a time: prompts → Kim generates → composite → next.

bookingApp.note: The direct-booking PRODUCT shown inside slides. Design language matches the Kalido / Smithe House booking engine (warm off-white + butter-yellow accent, elegant serif display + grotesk UI, 5-step flow: Dates·Categories·Rates·Summary·Details). Fictional demo hotel (Marlowe House) — the DESIGN is replicated, not a real client's brand. One demo, all month, for consistency.
bookingApp.renderMode: BARE SCREENS (no device frame) — laptop 1440x900 (rates 1440x1080), phone 460x996 — so they composite onto the blank white screen of a device inside a scene photo.
bookingApp.screens: laptop: hero · categories(rate-compare) · rates · modal(email-capture) · dashboard(owner). phone: hero · rates · confirm.
bookingApp.photos: Interior photos are Kim-generated into assets/app/<slot>.png (hero, studio, twobed, lifestyle); prompts in build/app/photo-prompts.md. Warm gradient placeholders until then.
bookingApp.composite: In a scene slide, `screen:{app:'laptop-hero', quad:[TL,TR,BR,BL] in slide px}` maps the UI onto the device's white screen via a perspective transform. Generate the scene with a BLANK WHITE device screen; read the 4 corners off the render to set the quad.

organicAccents.note: The hand-made 'alive' layer used mainly on scene slides. Every accent is a hand-drawn stroke (irregular, wobbly, rough-ended) tinted Verde Pixel — never a clean geometric rectangle.
organicAccents.marker: ==text== → torn-edge highlighter swipe behind the word.
organicAccents.cutout: optional subject.png (masked) composited above the scrim with a rough cream halo.
organicAccents.restraint: One or two accents per slide, maximum. The accent points at the ONE idea — over-marking kills it.

gridRules: Organic/flat checkerboard — scene covers at grid positions 1,3,5,7,9,11; systemized covers at 2,4,6,8,10,12.
No two covers of the same ARCHETYPE adjacent, including diagonally. The two MATRIX and the two SEAM covers sit at opposite corners of the grid.
At least FOUR light covers per twelve, at slots 2 and 8 plus one of {4,10} and one of {6,12}. Three light covers can never clear the grid (see myDesignLanguage.surfaces.rhythm).
A topic that has a scene version drops its flat HTML twin — nothing repeats in the same month.
Vary the cover treatment post-to-post so the feed never looks samey while staying one brand.
Verde Pixel is an accent only — one hero element per slide.

Path A visuals are designed/drawn — no stock or AI photography; product shots are CSS mockups or real composited screens. Path B uses AI-generated SCENE backgrounds only (never fake UI, logos, text, or a real identifiable person baked into the image).

format.platform: Instagram carousel (primary), reusable for TikTok slides

contentCategories.note: Two categories share ONE design system and ONE feed. Not two styles — same canvas, palette, type, motif, footer and one-accent rule.

fireYourMiddleman.job: Sell the argument for going direct.
fireYourMiddleman.pillars: THE PROBLEM · THE MATH · THE ALTERNATIVE · THE PROOF · THE DECISION

educational.job: Teach the craft — WordPress, the stack, how a booking system is built. Earns authority; feeds the campaign.
educational.pillars: THE STACK · THE BUILD · THE STANDARD · THE FIX · THE TRADEOFF
educational.coverSurface: ALWAYS light — this is the tile that fills the feed's light slot.
educational.paths: A by default; drawn, not photographed.
howItDiffers: Diagram-forward interiors: where a campaign slide puts a colossal number, an educational slide puts a STRUCTURE — a flow, a stack, a labelled anatomy, a before/after.
The pixel motif becomes the diagram primitive: cells as nodes, layers, steps.
Space Grotesk carries more weight (labels, field names, values, paths); display type shrinks because the diagram is the hero.
The lime accent points at the ANSWER — the one cell or step that is the lesson — not at the headline.
educational.staysTheSame: 1080x1350, Media Noche/Pantalla/Verde Pixel, Satoshi + Space Grotesk, pixel motif, progress ticks, one accent per slide, no logo/handle/swipe.

contentRepository: content/ideas/ — README.md (system + ideation workflow), stack.json, fire-your-middleman.json, educational-technical.json. Pull topics from here at ideation; never brainstorm from zero.
